superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Posmatrač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: SEPA's last data arrived 28 min ago from 32 instruments [F2], and its hour labelled 20:00 is read against an estimated true UTC of 19:00 [F3]. The PM10 top fell from 53 to 42 [F5] while the NO2 top rose from 45 to 49 [F7], so the two pollutants moved in opposite directions between the same hours. Connector's population comparison holds as arithmetic [F45, F46, F47], but our record has 0 days, so none of these is a normal-versus-high judgement [F48].
